about_the_game:
About Story

Song Kerr arrived in a city rumored to be haunted - Rust City... As the investigation deepens, she unravels numerous puzzles and explores the long-buried past of this city...

Main Characters

Song Kerr: The female protagonist of this work who comes to Rust City to investigate.

Lu Xiao hong: A wronged ghost who died unjustly, sealed and unable to move freely. Breaking her seal can turn her into a companion.

Tips

【? Fragments】Important items hidden throughout the scene, if collected all...?

【Ending】Multiple endings, but only one true ending.

【Monsters】Mutated giant insects and human experiments, with incredible attack power, please be careful to avoid.

【Scattered Notes】Viewing notes can provide hints.

Declaration

Hereby declare, the game's content is purely fictional! Any resemblance is purely coincidental! The game contains horror and bloody elements! Please proceed with caution if you are not comfortable!

short_description: A pixel-style horror puzzle RPG game where you will play as a girl named Song Kerr, using your wits to survive in Rust City while exploring the long-hidden truths among the tangled clues... Please note, do not break the rules: monsters will appear at midnight, do not go outside!
